info.title: Rotor
info.description: Rotor's HTTP API: workflows across Exciter, Armature and Stator. Every endpoint answers JSON; errors share one envelope. Sign in through the suite's identity provider; the session is a cookie.

A binding to a tool you are not connected to is refused with 409 code connections_needed, whose fields map each tool's name to its id (empty for a tool this installation does not have).
